source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 8: a x (b + c) + b x (c + a) + c x (a + b) = 0 by distributive and anti-commutative laws (book p.283). Proof, no key answer.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh cross product ke qawaneen (rules) se proof hai.
Dikhana hai ke lambi left side asal mein zero vector hai.
Plan: brackets kholein (distributive law), ulti tarteeb wale products ko minus ke saath likhein, phir joron mein cancel karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: koi bhi vectors \(\underline{a}, \underline{b}, \underline{c}\).
Saabit karna hai: left side \(= \underline{0}\).
Tareeqa: Do rules: distributive law \(\underline{u} \times (\underline{v} + \underline{w}) = \underline{u} \times \underline{v} + \underline{u} \times \underline{w}\) (Question 7 (iv)) aur \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u} = -\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) (Question 7 (ii)). Components ki zaroorat nahi, kyunke vectors ke components diye hi nahi gaye.

Har bracket kholein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \underline{a} \times \underline{b} + \underline{a} \times \underline{c}\]
\[+\ \underline{b} \times \underline{c} + \underline{b} \times \underline{a}\]
\[+\ \underline{c} \times \underline{a} + \underline{c} \times \underline{b}\]
Kyun: Distributive law se har bracket do products mein khul gaya. Dhyan rahe ke har product mein bahar wala vector pehle aur andar wala baad mein rahe; tarteeb badalna mana hai.

Ulti tarteeb wale products ko minus ke saath likhein
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = -\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\]
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{c} = -\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\]
\[\underline{c} \times \underline{b} = -\underline{b} \times \underline{c}\]
Kyun: Cross product anti-commutative hai: jagah badlo to sign badlo. Is tarah har product ek hi shakal mein aa gaya (\(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\), \(\underline{b} \times \underline{c}\), \(\underline{c} \times \underline{a}\)) aur ab inhein jama ya cancel karna aasaan hai.
Dhyan dein: Aam numbers ki tarah \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = \underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) likh dena bari ghalti hai; phir jawab \(2(\ldots)\) aayega, zero nahi.

Jore bana kar cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = (\underline{a} \times \underline{b} - \underline{a} \times \underline{b})\]
\[+ (\underline{b} \times \underline{c} - \underline{b} \times \underline{c})\]
\[+ (\underline{c} \times \underline{a} - \underline{c} \times \underline{a})\]
\[= \underline{0} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Har product ek dafa plus aur ek dafa minus ke saath aaya, is liye har jora zero ho gaya. Teen zero vectors ka jama zero vector, jo right side hai.
